div.head: II Cn 30.3a
div.ab: ⁊ ofgá man þæt þryfealde ordal þus: nime fife ⁊ beo he sylf syxta.
⁊ ofga man þæt þrifealde ordal þus: nime fife ⁊ beo sylf sixta.
Et inducatur triplex ordalium hoc modo: sumat V et idem sit sextus.
⁊ ofgá man þæt ðryfealde ordal ðus, nime fife ⁊ beo him sylf syxta.
And ofga man þæt þryfealde ordal þus: nime fife and beo he sylf syxta.
Und [Kläger] erzwinge (erreiche Inst. H) das dreifache Ordal folgendermassen: er wähle fünf [Eideshelfer] und sei selbst Sechster im [Anklage-]Eide.
And let [the plaintiff] compel (obtain, Inst. H) the threefold ordeal as follows: let him take five [oath-helpers] and be himself the sixth in the [accusing] oath.
And a case which involves the triple ordeal shall be opened as follows: five [compurgators] shall be selected by the accuser and he himself shall make a sixth.
And the three-fold ordeal is to be set on foot thus: he is to take five men and be himself the sixth.
And the threefold ordeal is to be undertaken thus: the accuser shall choose five witnesses, and he himself shall be the sixth.
div.note: beo he: beo him B; beo A
